SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.phone, u.email, u.employee_no, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.created_by, u.updated_by FROM sys_user u
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.username}, '%')
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.nickname}, '%')
AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.phone}, '%')
AND u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.email}, '%')
AND u.employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.employeeNo}, '%')
AND u.status = #{query.status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_dept ud INNER JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id WHERE ud.user_id = u.id AND dc.ancestor_id = #{query.deptId} )
ORDER BY ${orderBySql}

SELECT d.id, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, d.status, ud.is_primary FROM v_user_dept_effective ud INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON ud.dept_id = d.id WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ud.is_primary DESC, ud.created_at DESC

SELECT sp.id, sp.post_code, sp.post_name, sp.status, up.is_primary FROM v_user_post_effective up INNER JOIN sys_post sp ON up.post_id = sp.id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY up.is_primary DESC, up.created_at DESC

SELECT id, username, nickname FROM sys_user WHERE status = 1 AND ( username LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR email LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR employee_no LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
